//go:build e2e

package executor

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// pDisk writes where the disk went, as the store keeps it, under name.
func pDisk(name string) {
	out, _ := exec.Command("bash", "-c", `date +%s; df -B1 --output=used / | tail -1; sudo du -sb /var/lib/docker/* /var/lib/containerd/* 2>/dev/null | sort -k2; docker system df; docker image ls -a --no-trunc; docker ps -a --size; docker volume ls`).CombinedOutput()
	_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("TRIAL_OUT"), "disk-"+name+".txt"), out, 0o600)
}

func pB(ctx context.Context, t *testing.T, e *Executor, name, pkg string) {
	var log bytes.Buffer
	began := time.Now()
	_, err := e.Build(ctx, BuildRequest{App: "claims-portal", Package: pkg}, treeOf(t, "../demo/apps/claims-portal"), &log)
	fmt.Printf("STAGE %s %.1f s %v\n", name, time.Since(began).Seconds(), err)
	_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("TRIAL_OUT"), "log-"+name+".txt"), log.Bytes(), 0o600)
}

func TestProbe(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 40*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	e := &Executor{Join: []string{}}
	pDisk("0-empty")
	_, err := e.BuilderImage(ctx)
	must(t, err)
	_, err = e.RunImageID(ctx)
	must(t, err)
	pDisk("1-builder-and-run")
	pB(ctx, t, e, "first", "pkg_prb1")
	pDisk("2-after-first-build")
	must(t, os.WriteFile("/tmp/probe-verbose", nil, 0o600))
	pB(ctx, t, e, "second-timed", "pkg_prb2")
	must(t, os.Remove("/tmp/probe-verbose"))
	pDisk("3-after-second-build")
	pB(ctx, t, e, "third", "pkg_prb3")
	pDisk("4-after-third-build")
	_ = exec.Command("docker", "image", "prune", "-f").Run()
	pDisk("5-after-image-prune")
}
